text:
olivia: Just opened a PR that adds a compact \"how-to\" for Private installs in sealed networks: minimal firewall examples, offline-bundle verification, and a tiny conn-checker script. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5032

pierre: quick scan looks good. a few items: HSM vendors differ - some use 5698/tcp, others recommend 5698/tcp + 5699/tcp for admin. suggest we document 5698 as required and 5699 as optional/management. also prefer \"allowlist\" vs older phrasing.

maya: thanks. added a short sentence about DNS resolution when using an internal registry mirror (need hosts entry or internal DNS). customers in airgapped sites trip on this.

olivia: added both HSM ports with the optional label and a kube Service example plus a bare-metal nftables snippet. changed wording to \"allowlist\". included example host entry: `10.10.2.5 registry.internal.local registry.redwood.ai` for mirror setups.

support-bot: Lint: OK. Broken links: 0. CI: queued.

pierre: one more edge case: some RHEL/CentOS installs hit SELinux denied errors when bundle files are extracted under /opt. recommend `restorecon -R /opt/offline-bundles` and a short note about extracting as root.

maya: small OS caveat: on ext3/ext4 with older kernels long S3-key-derived filenames can exceed limits. suggest example path `/opt/offline/redwood-2026-03.tar.gz` and note <256 char path limit.

olivia: added both notes. also included a 3-line conn-checker that does TCP connect + `openssl s_client` cert verify. snippet:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
nc() { timeout 3 bash -c "</dev/tcp/$1/$2"; }
nc registry.redwood.ai 443 || exit 1
openssl s_client -connect registry.redwood.ai:443 -servername registry.redwood.ai < /dev/null | grep "CN=" || exit 2
echo OK
````

pierre: nice. security nit: don't say \"allow all egress\" anywhere. instead recommend the minimal domains for installer downloads (e.g., `rdw-inference-updates.redwood.ai:443`) and note registries if using public images.

olivia: fixed wording to recommend explicit domains only. also added a tip to retry downloads up to 3 times because we've seen transient 502/503 from mirrors during heavy load.

maya: can someone validate the smoke flow on a semi-airgapped VM with an internal mirror? I can help tomorrow morning with logs if needed.

pierre: I ran a quick check on staging (ubuntu-22, installer v0.12.4):
[2026-03-10T09:12:01Z] fetch mirror -> 200
[2026-03-10T09:12:05Z] verify sha256 -> OK
[2026-03-10T09:12:20Z] extract -> OK
[2026-03-10T09:12:40Z] kms -> connected
[2026-03-10T09:12:45Z] hsm handshake -> OK
[2026-03-10T09:12:55Z] health -> http://localhost:8080/health -> 200
SMOKE PASS

pierre: one transient: initial registry connect returned 503, retried and succeeded. logs attached to the PR.

olivia: perfect. I'll merge once CI passes. filing a follow-up to add annotated conn-checker output screenshots and an expanded troubleshooting section (issue #5033).

maya: thanks all. tagging support if customers need the conn-checker output format for tickets.
